items.headline: Chainflip Hack Balloons to $12M, $FLIP Offers Bounty
items.summary: Chainflip disclosed a 122.9 BTC theft, pushing losses to $12M across BTC, ETH and stablecoins. The protocol is offering the hacker a 10% bounty, with $FLIP holders watching the Monday deadline.

items.headline: $CYBER Probes $1M Bridge Exploit, Korean Exchanges Freeze
items.summary: Cyber is investigating a suspected $1M bridge exploit as Upbit and Bithumb froze $CYBER deposits and withdrawals, citing a security incident.

items.headline: $ANT Token Debuts on Solana With $135M Day-One Volume
items.summary: The Anthropic-linked $ANT token launched on Solana with a reported $134.7M in first-24-hour trading volume. Backpack says it's redeemable for shares, though holder rights differ from brokerage customers.

items.headline: $RAILGUN Community Touts Post-Quantum Privacy Prototype
items.summary: A ZKNOX wallet proof of concept on Sepolia demos new note encryption for $RAILGUN, an early step toward quantum-resistant private transactions — though spending isn't quantum-proof yet.

items.headline: DCG's Zcash Miner Fortitude Clears Nasdaq Listing Vote
items.summary: Fortitude, DCG's Zcash mining arm, won shareholder approval for its Nasdaq debut even as $ZEC trades 55% below its all-time high.
